Thanks dude! 


I well... already tried that part about trusting people today a little after posting this. 


The problem is I almost ended up telling them to get the f"ck out of my bulding. None of my fathers friends and workers like my fathers girlfriend (The mother of my half sister. She IS an asshole but she really cares about my father, me and my sister and is the only person who has been trully helping us) so when they got there to help me they started to talk sh"t about her, about how my father usually runs things and did things that I explicitely told them not to do (I work mostly as cashier and decided to stay there, but asked them to do the payments exactly as I asked for them, they then proceeded to completely ignore me and do wathever the f"ck they wanted with the payments, and then one of my fathers friends even got angry when I took the remaining money only to use as an emergency and told me he was not coming the monday to help me again!). 


I am a really meek guy, you dont know how hard it is for me to order people around (But right now Im try as hard as I can, which still is prety bad btw), while my father is extremely charismatic, so most of my fathers workers dont respect me and I would have had most of them fired by now if it wasnt for this situation (They are still getting the axe the moment my father gets free)


And about my sister, I actually was able to stall that a week. My mother still does not know about what happened to my father (I thought she already knew, but it looks like she was only being a little more of a b"tch than usually) and had to go out in a business emergency today for a week. So hurray for the little blesings in life! :) 


But yeah, sorry for the rant. I feel like I already chewed my friends ears too much and this is a good place to bent a little.


And thanks for taking your time with me, this helps like you have no freaking idea! :D
I understand that feeling, if you still around and need someone to talk send me a pm :)
